Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background

Record Class MenuView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background.MenuView
Record Components:
menuId - the menu's ID in guis.yml, such as party.members
name - the menu's own name: its title without the texture
rows - the menu's size in rows
elements - every visible element, in the order placed, mapped to the state it is drawn in; an element without states maps to an empty string
entries - how many entries each content list the menu reported holds, across all pages
page - the page on screen, counting from 1
pages - how many pages there are, at least 1
view - the view the menu reports, such as no-party; empty for a menu with one
background - what the background decided, or null while conditions are being tested and for a menu whose texture Zentrix does not decide: one without rules in guis.yml that no resolver covers
public record MenuView(@NotNull String menuId, @NotNull String name, int rows, @NotNull Map<String,String> elements, @NotNull Map<String,Integer> entries, int page, int pages, @NotNull String view, @Nullable MenuBackgroundResult background) extends Record
What one open Zentrix menu shows, as its background rules see it.

Zentrix records this while the menu places its buttons: every element placed through the menu's guis.yml layout counts as shown, in the state it was drawn in. It is the same record the shown, state, entries, page and view conditions are tested against, and what /zx gui debug prints.

A view is a snapshot: it does not follow the menu after it was taken.

Since:
1.15.0
